content.text:
Three endpoints require `ManageUsers`, all on the `User` aggregate root:

- `POST /users` (add)
- `PUT /users/{id}` (update)
- `DELETE /users/{id}` (remove)

`GET /users` and `GET /users/{id}` only require an authenticated user.

**Where it's enforced**
- **Declared in the model:** `specs/aggregates.yaml:37-41` sets `mandatory_right: ManageUsers` on `add`, `update` and `remove`.
- **Applied to the endpoints:** the generated `src/UM.Api/UMEndpoints.g.cs:54,61,68` calls `.RequireRight("ManageUsers")` on each of the three routes.
- **Checked at request time:** `RequireRight` in `src/UM.Api/Framework/Security.f.cs:26` applies the ASP.NET authorization policy `right:ManageUsers`. `RightPolicyProvider` builds that policy on demand. It requires an authenticated user holding the `ManageUsers` claim, or `*`, which grants every right.

The right is also defined in `src/UM.Application/UMRights.g.cs:7` and seeded in `src/UM.Infrastructure/UMDbContext.cs:16`.

I didn't read the rest of `RightPolicyProvider`, so the claim check itself rests on its doc comment.
